import math
import unittest

from solution import progressive_bands


class ProgressiveBandsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_accumulation_propagates_through_all_prior_bands(self):
        bands = [[1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30], [-4, 0, 4], [0.5, 1.5, 2.5]]
        snapshot = [band[:] for band in bands]
        result = progressive_bands(bands)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            [1, 2, 3],
            [11, 22, 33],
            [7, 22, 37],
            [7.5, 23.5, 39.5],
        ])
        self.assertEqual(bands, snapshot)

    def test_single_band_is_copied(self):
        source = [[1.0, -2]]
        result = progressive_bands(source)
        self.assertEqual(result, [[1.0, -2]])
        self.assertIsNot(result, source)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], source[0])
        source[0][0] = 99
        self.assertEqual(result, [[1.0, -2]])

    def test_returned_inner_lists_are_independent(self):
        result = progressive_bands([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1], result[2])
        result[0][0] = 100
        self.assertEqual(result[1], [4, 6])
        self.assertEqual(result[2], [9, 12])

    def test_generator_inputs(self):
        bands = (iter(values) for values in ([1, 1], [2, 3], [4, 5]))
        self.assertEqual(progressive_bands(bands), [[1, 1], [3, 4], [7, 9]])

    def test_outer_validation(self):
        for value in ("abc", b"abc", 5, None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    progressive_bands(value)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            progressive_bands([])

    def test_band_shape_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            progressive_bands([3])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            progressive_bands(["12"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            progressive_bands([[]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            progressive_bands([[1, 2], [3]])

    def test_coordinate_validation(self):
        for value in (True, "1", None, 1 + 2j):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    progressive_bands([[value]])
        for value in (math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    progressive_bands([[value]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
